current_state: Public-template regression is green; production remains read-only and blocked on canonical runtime identity, live source health, authenticated approvals, reproducibility, audit anchoring, and bounded pilot evidence.

tasks.title: Add the canonical runtime identity gate
tasks.objective: Add a fail-closed manifest and validator that prove the configured Hermes workdir, repository remote, branch, commit, and public-template mode before readiness checks run.
steps: Inspect existing readiness and path checks.
Define the minimal canonical runtime manifest with no private absolute path in public mode.
Resolve live Git identity read-only and compare every declared field.
Fail on missing repository, remote mismatch, branch mismatch, dirty tracked source, or commit mismatch.
Add positive and negative tests.
acceptance: A missing or mismatched commit fails closed.
A dirty tracked source tree fails while ignored runtime data is reported separately.
Public output contains no private absolute path.
The validator performs no mutation or external action.
stop_conditions: The canonical checkout has not been selected by the owner.
Validation would require changing Hermes, cron, Drive, or live runtime state.

tasks.title: Require a seven-run source-canary window
tasks.objective: Extend the existing reliability gate so production routing cannot advance without seven consecutive scheduled receipts showing every configured read-only source adapter healthy.
steps: Trace the current source-health receipt format.
Add a bounded chronological seven-run evaluator.
Reject gaps, duplicates, stale receipts, partial adapter sets, and any unhealthy result.
Keep all checks read-only.
Add deterministic fixtures in the existing test file.
acceptance: Six healthy runs remain blocked.
Any unhealthy or missing adapter resets the consecutive window.
Stale or duplicated receipts cannot satisfy the gate.
No source adapter is invoked by the evaluator.
stop_conditions: The current receipt schema cannot identify scheduled runs deterministically.
The change would enable live production routing.

tasks.title: Bind owner decisions to an authenticated principal contract
tasks.objective: Replace trust in arbitrary owner strings at the decision boundary with a typed verifier contract that fails closed when authenticated principal evidence is absent or mismatched.
steps: Trace every caller of the owner decision entrypoint.
Define a verifier interface using existing receipt fields and no live provider dependency.
Require verified subject, issuer, audience, expiry, and decision scope.
Fail closed for missing, expired, mismatched, or caller-supplied identity.
Add negative tests before integration.
acceptance: Caller-provided owner text alone cannot authorize a decision.
Expired or scope-mismatched identity fails.
The verifier contract is injectable for deterministic tests.
No live identity provider is contacted.
stop_conditions: No stable decision receipt or approval scope exists to bind.
The task requires selecting or configuring a live identity provider.

tasks.title: Prove atomic single-use approval consumption
tasks.objective: Make the approval decision path reject reuse, payload drift, expiry, and concurrent consumption before any future executor can be connected.
steps: Trace approval verification and receipt-write callers.
Define the exact atomicity invariant at the shared boundary.
Reject consumed, expired, mismatched, or concurrently claimed approvals.
Keep missing policy/ledger services fail-closed.
Add replay and concurrency regression tests.
acceptance: An approval can authorize at most one exact effect intent.
Payload or scope drift is denied.
Concurrent claims produce at most one success.
No external effect tool is added or invoked.
stop_conditions: The current local storage cannot provide an atomic primitive.
The proposed change would weaken fail-closed behavior when OPA or the ledger is unavailable.

tasks.title: Make dependency drift an explicit release blocker
tasks.objective: Add a deterministic dependency-lock coverage check that reports unpinned runtime requirements without guessing upgrades or performing network installation.
steps: Inventory runtime requirement files and CI installation commands.
Define exact pin and duplicate/conflict rules.
Add a read-only validator with machine-readable output.
Test unpinned, duplicated, conflicting, URL, and marker cases.
Add the validator to CI only after local tests pass.
acceptance: Every installed production dependency is covered by an exact lock or explicit approved exception.
The validator performs no network access.
Conflicting duplicate requirements fail.
CI runs the same validator.
stop_conditions: A requirement source is generated externally and cannot be reproduced.
Resolving a conflict requires choosing a new package version.

tasks.title: Export a privacy-safe ledger checkpoint
tasks.objective: Create a deterministic checkpoint over the append-only event ledger that can be stored externally later without exposing business data or pretending to be a deployed trust anchor.
steps: Reuse the canonical event ordering and hashing rules.
Emit only count, terminal hash, source digest, timestamp policy, and schema version.
Verify tamper and truncation detection.
Document that external anchoring remains a separate human/infra gate.
Add deterministic tests.
acceptance: Checkpoint generation is deterministic for identical bytes.
Tamper and truncation are detected.
No tender, supplier, buyer, price, credential, or owner data is emitted.
No external anchor is contacted or claimed.
stop_conditions: The current event ordering cannot be reproduced deterministically.
The checkpoint would expose raw business identifiers or personal data.

tasks.title: Complete supervised shadow and bounded pilot evidence
tasks.objective: Collect seven healthy scheduled source runs, fourteen clean shadow days, an owner-approved read-only canary, restore evidence, and a thirty-day bounded pilot with zero prohibited external effects.
steps: Obtain authenticated owner approval for the exact read-only pilot scope.
Collect scheduled receipts without backfilling or simulation.
Run the restore and incident drills.
Review weekly policy, evidence, and external-effect metrics.
Record final owner/security signoff or blockers.
acceptance: Seven consecutive source runs are fully healthy.
Fourteen shadow days meet the documented thresholds.
The thirty-day pilot records zero policy violations and zero prohibited external effects.
Restore and incident drills pass at the same immutable commit.
stop_conditions: Owner approval is absent, expired, or not scope-bound.
Any portal submit, DSC, payment, final price, classification, origin, delivery, or supplier commitment is requested.
tasks.blocker: Scheduled elapsed evidence, authenticated owner approval, and supervised real pilot are required.
